sourceBasis.step: Add opposite unit clauses on two fresh variables. With L=n+2 positions and 2L−1 filler symbols, the two clauses ensure that both truth values and all fillers occur, giving q=2d+3. Some filler is absent from every length-L center. The words using that filler require a satisfying literal in every clause. Conversely, a satisfying assignment agrees with every word. The encoding is polynomial and d=n+1 preserves the effective exponent scale.
